scripts.build: prisma generate && prisma migrate deploy && next build
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run pull:env && docker compose up -d && npm run db:init
scripts.db:init: npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.refresh: npm run pull:env && npx prisma generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:generate
scripts.reset: docker compose down -v && npm run pull:env && npm install && docker compose up -d --build && npm run db:init
scripts.db:generate: docker compose exec app npx prisma generate
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec app npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:push: docker compose exec app npx prisma db push
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec app npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:sync: npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:studio: docker compose exec app npx prisma studio --port 5555 --browser none
scripts.clean: docker compose down -v && docker compose up --build -d
scripts.validate: npm run format:write && npm run lint
